title: On the stability of Lamb-Chaplygin dipole for the 2D Euler equation
summary: The Lamb-Chaplygin dipole is a traveling wave solution to the 2D incompressible Euler equation, whose orbital stability was established in [Abe-Choi, 2022] and [Abe-Choi-Jeong, 2025] assuming the odd symmetry in $x_2$ (O) and non-negativity in upper half-plane (N). This paper is devoted to further study of its stability in the following two aspects. Firstly, we prove the spectral stability of the linearized operator around the Lamb-Chaplygin dipole without conditions (O) or (N), based on the index theory established in [Lin-Zeng, 2022].
